title: predatory-citations-arxiv-2025: Reproducibility scripts for 'Measuring Citations to Predatory Journals at Scale: Lessons from arXiv's 2025 BibTeX Files'
description: Scripts that extract the .bib files from arXiv source packages and compute the numbers of the paper 'Measuring Citations to Predatory Journals at Scale: Lessons from arXiv's 2025 BibTeX Files' from the assessment results of the tool Aletheia-Probe. Code only: no data and no per-citation results are included. Research-grade code, not a maintained tool.
